name: Thief and Troll
source:
When I woke up, I found myself in an unfamiliar cave.

The sticky air clung to my skin, and the sunlight didn't penetrate.

When I sat up, trying to understand what had happened, I found that the clothes I had been wearing had disappeared.

Someone must have taken all of my clothes and tools while I was unconscious to prevent me from resisting.

In other words, I had been held captive by something.

Unfortunately, I was no princess who would just wait for rescue.

I didn't know where I was, but I had to escape from this cave and teach my captors a lesson...

translation:
醒来时，我发现自己身处一座陌生的洞窟。

黏腻的空气贴在皮肤上，这里连一丝阳光都透不进来。

我坐起身，试图弄清发生了什么，却发现原本穿在身上的衣服全都不见了。

一定是有人趁我昏迷时拿走了所有衣物和工具，防止我反抗。

换句话说，我被某种东西俘虏了。

可惜，我不是那种只会坐等救援的公主。

虽然不知道自己身在何处，但我必须逃出这座洞窟，再给俘虏我的家伙一点教训……
